title: How busy are the GPUs?
story: Geiss-01 has 8 GPUs that everyone in the course shares. Check how many are free right now.

tasks.text: Report how many GPUs are free

hints: `nvidia-smi` shows every GPU and how much of it is in use.
Run `nvidia-smi`. The last line says how many are free.
Run `nvidia-smi`, read the line "N of 8 GPUs are free", then type N in the answer box.
